delivered.body: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement PARTIES. This Agreement is between Northwind Capital and Oakstone Ventures. 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to explore a potential transaction and will share confidential information. 2. CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS. The receiving party shall protect confidential information disclosed under this Agreement using at least reasonable care and shall use it only to evaluate the potential transaction. These obligations apply during the term of this Agreement and for three years after each disclosure. 3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the date of signing. 4. REMEDIES. Breach may be enjoined and damages sought.
